scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.
clarifications.D: I have no specific spring section or educational program in mind.
L: Located in Turin, conveniently positioned relative to existing school clusters, not fixed on one single quarter.
clarifications.Cb: I have no requirement on gross square meters or toddler capacity for the spring section.
clarifications.Ce: I have no requirement on the energy class.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.
